convert_musicldm_checkpoint_to_diffusers: convert a MusicLDM checkpoint file to a diffusers MusicLDMPipeline and save it
load_musicldm_pipeline_from_ckpt: load a MusicLDM pipeline from a .ckpt or .safetensors checkpoint file
convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint: convert a MusicLDM UNet checkpoint state dict to diffusers UNet2DConditionModel format
convert_ldm_vae_checkpoint: convert a MusicLDM VAE checkpoint state dict to diffusers AutoencoderKL format
convert_open_clap_checkpoint: convert a MusicLDM CLAP text model checkpoint to transformers ClapModel format
